analyst_view.overall: NEC (12th, 14 points) host FC Twente (3rd, 27 points) on Sunday evening at the Goffertstadion. Both sides play in Europe on Thursday night: NEC at home to Rennes in the Europa League, Twente away at Freiburg in the Conference League, so each has about three days to recover and Twente also travel back from Germany; the numbers have no congestion adjustment for this game, so some rotation and tired legs are not in them. NEC lost 1-4 at home to PSV last time and are without Nuytinck and Emre Mor, with Perr Schuurs and Dennis Geiger doubtful (the numbers take Schuurs off, -8.9% on NEC's goals). Twente, under John van den Brom, scored 22 in their last six and edged ten-man Willem II 2-1; Unnerstall, Bruns and Thorvaldsen are out (counted), and the club also lists Van den Belt and Kurowski as injured. Sander van der Eijk referees, with a high card record the numbers already add; my small trims to goals and shots are for the Thursday-Sunday turnaround.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals, 1.9 for Twente, raised for Twente's 22 goals in their last six and lowered for NEC's absences (Schuurs, Mor). Both teams play European games on Thursday night and the numbers have no congestion adjustment here, so I expect some rotation and a less open game; I trim to about 3.1.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners, 5.2 for NEC, already moved for NEC winning plenty lately (38 in six) and Twente conceding very few (7 in six). Tired legs could cut attacking volume a little, but corners depend more on how the game goes, so I stay at about 9.8.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.9 cards, already raised for Sander van der Eijk (3.6 cards a game over 55 games, +19.8%). Fatigue after European games can bring late fouls, but it can also make a game flatter, and nothing else points to a heated match, so I stay at about 3.9.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.6 shots, with a big boost for Twente's 150 shots in their last six (+13.9%). Twente play at Freiburg on Thursday and NEC host Rennes, and a preview expects rotation on both sides; the numbers don't see that, so I trim to about 27.2.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.6 shots on target, raised for Twente's sharp recent shooting (55 on target in six, +10.8%). With both sides coming off Thursday European games and likely to rotate a little, I trim to about 10.2.
